expect_red: a local-file link renders only where the origin can follow it

mutations.contract: The "open the PDF" link renders only on an origin that can service a file: navigation. Chrome refuses every navigation from an http(s) page to a file: URL, so on a served page the click did nothing at all (Jeff, 2026-09-15) -- and a control that does nothing must be absent, not explained.
mutations.note: Reverts the one call to the pure URL builder, which is exactly the pre-fix code. VA.fileUrl is deliberately still pure and still exported, so this mutation is the real regression rather than a synthetic one. Reasoning and the measurements: docs/sessions/lessons/LESSONS_20260915_viewer_component_names_and_reference_copy.md.
